config.command.description: Executable used to start dsh web when dsh.serverUrl is empty. The default uses pnpm dlx; npx remains a compatible fallback when pnpm is unavailable. Use dsh or an absolute path if the CLI is installed locally. Arguments are configured separately; Windows batch and PowerShell launchers use the shell when required.
config.commandArgs.description: Arguments passed to dsh.command when dsh.serverUrl is empty. The default runs pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --no-open so the local RPC server starts without opening a browser. A --port argument is appended when no port is present. The extension pins the published package version: an unversioned @deepseek-ai/dsh here launches the Runtime version this build speaks. Write @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version> to choose one yourself.
config.npxTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for npx or pnpm to download the DSH package and start its web server. If the attempt looks like a package-manager download failure, an alternate registry is tried once.
config.npmRegistry.description: Alternate npm-compatible registry used once after an npx or pnpm download/start failure. The default is npmmirror; if the active package manager is already using it, the official registry is tried instead. Leave empty to disable the fallback.
config.enableCompaction.description: Enable the official /compact command when the extension starts its own DSH web server.
config.serverUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL for an already running, trusted dsh web runtime. When set, the extension attaches to it instead of spawning dsh.command. Loopback HTTP is allowed; remote runtimes must use HTTPS. For dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 and later, use the tokenized URL printed by dsh web.
config.serverPort.description: Port passed to dsh web when dsh.serverUrl is empty and dsh.commandArgs has no port. Zero asks dsh to choose a free port.
config.autoStart.description: Start or attach to dsh web automatically when the extension activates. If false, start it from the status label or with DSH: Start dsh Web Runtime.
config.installWhenMissing.description: When dsh, pnpm, npm and npx are all unavailable, download a standalone DSH Runtime from the pinned release source and manage it locally. Other custom commands are never replaced.
config.runtimeVersion.description: Version of the standalone DSH Runtime to download and install when no local dsh toolchain is available. Runtime storage formats may be incompatible across major preview updates.
config.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the dsh web HTTP health check after starting or attaching.
config.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for one Harness RPC, including reconnect history rebaselines. Live assistant output is delivered over WebSocket and is not polled.
config.maxContextBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of the assembled <ide_context> block included in one prompt.
config.terminalHistorySize.description: Number of recent shell commands kept in memory per terminal. Only commands reported by VS Code Shell Integration after extension activation are captured; terminal output is never persisted.
config.persistSession.description: Reuse the last dsh session ID for the current workspace when possible. Chat messages and attached context are not persisted.
config.apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference passed to dsh.credentials.set when using DSH: Configure API Key. The key is also encrypted in VS Code SecretStorage when balance display is enabled.
config.agentStatusLabel.description: Optional fixed text shown while DSH is streaming an assistant response. Leave empty to randomly choose an item from dsh.agentStatusLabels. A companion extension can temporarily override either setting through the exported API.
config.agentStatusLabels.description: Candidate labels randomly selected once per streaming agent turn when dsh.agentStatusLabel is empty.
config.balanceRefreshIntervalMs.descript: Interval for refreshing the DeepSeek balance status bar item.
config.enableEffortKnob.description: Show the chibi runner sprite as the reasoning effort slider knob. Disable to use the native slider handle.
